body.name: R
body.def: \(R=(R_1,R_2^{[\cdot]})\), where \(R_{1av}\) is infection under assignment \(a\) and a period-one controlled challenge by variant \(v\); \(R^{[0]}_{2av}\) is the period-two controlled response after no period-one exposure, and \(R^{[u]}_{2av}\), \(u\in\mathcal V\), is the period-two controlled response after a period-one exposure to \(u\) that did not infect
body.role: controlled challenge response type allowing noninfecting-exposure priming
